title: inventory-service: elevated latency and errors
description: Customer support escalation: error budget burn on inventory-service; 17.5% of requests failing at peak and some requests timing out.
root_cause_detail: External dependency warehouse-api degraded and responded slowly; inventory-service calls exceeded the 1500ms client timeout.
expected_symptoms: inventory-service downstream_latency_ms rises from ~133ms to ~1.2s (client timeout 1500ms)
timeout and retry logs on calls from inventory-service to warehouse-api
inventory-service p95 latency rises to ~896ms, error rate up to ~17.5%
inventory-service CPU and memory stay near baseline
resolution: Failed over to the secondary warehouse-api region and tuned the inventory-service timeout and retry budget.
